name: pro-core
description: Universal base skills and guardrails: find-skills, using-pro-dev (the cross-lifecycle router that maps a task to the right phase and skill, including bridge skills like impeccable-bridge, qa-suite, and lavish), and dream (memory consolidation over Claude Code auto-memory: scans session transcripts for corrections, decisions, preferences, and patterns, merges the findings into the memory files, and rebuilds a lean MEMORY.md index under 200 lines). /gh universal GitHub workflow command (briefing, new, commit, push, pr, ship, sync, resolve). /dream runs a consolidation on demand, with dry-run and status modes. /kaizen raises the bar one notch per run from a planning repo: it judges each tracked project against its own profile and current practice, red-teams it, applies one reversible improvement, briefs the rest and writes a dated ledger and HTML report; /kaizen init scaffolds the planning repo. PreToolUse hook blocks dangerous Bash (force-push to main, rm -rf /, .env redirects, sudo, chmod 777, curl|bash) and reads each git push for the forms that block misses (a delete of a protected branch, refs/heads/main, a bare push on main, git -C, --all, the default branch or a declared one), which it flags under its own protected-push mode: warn by default, deny only when mode.protected-push says enforce. A second PreToolUse hook on Read, Grep and Bash flags a read of a dotenv file (not .env.example), a private SSH key, a .pem file, .npmrc, a credentials file or a service-account JSON under its own secret-read mode: warn by default, deny only when mode.secret-read says enforce. scripts/env-check.py says whether a key is set (present, empty or missing) and never prints its value. A second PreToolUse Bash hook flags rm, rmdir, unlink, find -delete, find -exec rm and git clean whose target resolves outside the project root, with the temp folders and the pro-dev state folder exempt, under its own delete-outside mode: warn by default, deny only when mode.delete-outside says enforce. SessionStart hook nudges parallel subagent dispatch. A Stop hook flags when a 24h memory consolidation is due, per project, and a SessionStart hook nudges the next session to run /dream. A UserPromptSubmit hook recalls the memories relevant to each prompt, ranking the project's memory notes with BM25 and injecting nothing when nothing clears the score floor. A second Stop hook keeps a dated session ledger under the memory directory so consolidation knows which transcripts to read. /pro-dev install|update|check sets up and refreshes the bridge engines from one registry, updates the pro-dev plugins in every scope that covers the repo and health-checks the install; a SessionStart hook nudges /pro-dev update when the registry changed.
